findings.text: the within-1pct numerator subtracts the three census sessions that are absent from the section from a compared base of 49 that never contained them, so 40/49 is recorded where the two files it summarises support 43 of the 49 present sessions within tolerance; the wrong figure is quoted in the manifest, in docs/plans/the-fleet-reports-its-velocity.html and in docs/evidence/archive/the-fleet-reports-its-velocity-landed.html, so every reader of the landing record gets a number that does not reconcile with the itemised list printed directly beneath it.

the landed denominator is the in-window promote commit alone and does not reproduce the census for six of the 49 comparable sessions (five by a single node, 8fac263d by 22 in the other direction), so the plan's "agree within 1%" done-when is unmet; the manifest states the cause as a source difference and my rescaling check confirms the response and token readers are exact, which locates the defect in the denominator's definition rather than in the accounting.

item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records 11 passed exit 0, the negative control's 2 failed/4 passed exit 1, measurement_result 40 of 49, and the nine out-of-tolerance sessions by id with a stated cause; its gate command at head be18adb4 returns 11 passed EXIT=0 when re-run independently.

justifications.evidence: the gate asserts the accounting on synthesised fixtures and the parity run is recorded with its 647-second capture in measurement.log, but the recorded headline is arithmetically wrong — measure_coordinator_cost.py:128 subtracts the three sessions absent from the section from a base of 49 that never contained them — and that figure then reached the manifest, the plan landing record and the evidence archive.
justifications.fit: reckon/velocity.py follows the module's own idiom — module-level roots beside the existing CODE and RUN_STORE constants, ratio() reuse, and the section-description table extended at reckon/velocity.py:1431 — introduces no name the repository naming rules forbid (the naming checks are clean on both changed Python paths), and a ruff run from inside the tree at head be18adb4 names neither changed Python path.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/velocity.py:785-870 implements the section the goal names including the unattributed bucket, and every raw per-session response and token figure reproduces the census exactly (my check: ratio 1.000000 on all five token keys and on the response count for all six differing sessions), leaving the landed denominator as the only divergence.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff is inside the declared write paths and both document edits are pure insertions, the only deleted line in the whole diff being the measure() signature that the transcript_root kwarg extends at reckon/velocity.py:905.
